summary: Central Puerto S.A. disclosed via Form 6-K, a US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report, that it and wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. repurchased treasury shares under Article 64 et seq. of Argentina's Capital Markets Law. CPSA bought 120,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at AR$2,068.22 average (AR$248,187,004 total); Proener bought 30,000 ADRs (300,000 share equivalent) on the NYSE at US$12.83 (US$385,067.12). Both trades executed 15-Oct-2026, settling 16-Oct-2026, and stayed below 25% of the 90-day average daily volume. Watch buyback pace and any ADR/local price arbitrage.
